# nana 研酒所: live music bar in SS13 Subang Jaya, Malaysia

> Official website of nana 研酒所, a fusion food and live music bar in SS13, Subang Jaya ("dinner first, music later"). Live band every night from 9pm. Book by WhatsApp; walk-ins are welcome daily.

- Website: https://gonana.my/
- Chinese: 梳邦现场音乐酒吧
- Address: 2 Jalan SS 13/3A, Subang Jaya Industrial Estate, 47500 Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12-897 4221
- Hours: 5:00pm–2:00am daily; live band 9:00pm–12:15am
- Kitchen: dinner from 5pm; late-night ramen from 9:30pm; kitchen last call 12:45am
- Happy hour: before 8:30pm. Beer buckets (5 bottles) buy 1 free 1, Guinness 10 glasses RM175, Roku gin RM388 a bottle, crispy hand-rolls from RM6.80, pork chop / chicken chop RM16.80
- Food highlights (RM, before 10% service charge and SST): 800g fresh clam (lala) pots RM50–59 (house signature: Maggi curry + parmesan, RM55); crispy hand-rolls RM12–18; hand-wrap rice RM28–35; pasta RM28.80–42.80; chops RM28; bar snacks RM10–25; 3-inch cakes RM28–29
- Drinks highlights: beer buckets RM118–138; signature cocktails RM35–65, most with an alcohol-free version from RM25; Flaming Lamborghini RM128; Choya from RM258; Sunday to Wednesday bottle sets with food from RM288 (Roku gin set for 4 RM488); spirits from RM468 (Roku gin) to RM3,588 (Kweichow Moutai)
- Bottle keeping: spirits 60 days, beer 30 days
- Membership: Nana Play, free at https://play.gonana.my/ (Malaysian phone number, nothing to download). Every RM100 on the bill earns 1 chip; chips buy fries, cocktails, up to a bottle of champagne; one reward a night; members get a free birthday treat, 3 days either side of their birthday (mini cake or Flaming Lamborghini), and the band sings
- Dietary: non-halal (menu includes pork and alcohol)
- Age policy: under-18 guests must leave by 8:30pm; strictly 18+ after 8:30pm
- Minimum spend: stage sofa RM300, on Fri/Sat/public-holiday-eve nights only; no sofa minimum on weekdays or the public-holiday day itself
- Bookings: WhatsApp with date, time and pax. No deposit; tables are held 15 minutes. Chat in English or Chinese.
- Weekday company dinners: Mondays to Wednesdays are the easiest nights for a big table. No minimum spend on weekdays, except on a public-holiday eve. Guests order from the food and drinks menu. Book on WhatsApp; no deposit.
- Private events: book the whole venue Sunday to Thursday (not Friday, Saturday or a public-holiday eve) for up to 250 guests. Minimum spend RM18,000 before 10% service charge and SST: a buffet at RM50–RM60 per person, then anything from the menu (promotions don't count; no free-flow). Includes a 3-piece live band (3 sets of 45 minutes), the stage and a mic. Times agreed per event. A 50% deposit within 3 working days holds the date; the rest is paid on the night. The date can be moved once. Groups of 50 or fewer: part of the venue, order as usual, no extra charge (no stage). https://gonana.my/events/
- Smoking: no cigarettes indoors
- Navigation: search "nana SS13" on Waze or Grab
- This week's line-up (new posters every Monday): https://gonana.my/#week
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/nana.ss13
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/CddBMPbaehJuaard7
- [Full menu in text, with prices](https://gonana.my/#menu-text)
- [Food menu (PDF)](https://gonana.my/assets/menu/food.pdf)
- [Drinks menu (PDF)](https://gonana.my/assets/menu/drinks.pdf)
